name: IsAsciiLetter (a-z, A-Z; byte argument on the stack)
notes: Test IniFile_IsAsciiLetter: all 256 byte values. Hooked.

name: IsCanonicalAbsolutePath(const char*) (X:\ or \\ prefix, no "\." or "/.")
notes: Test IniFile_IsCanonicalAbsolutePath: fixed edge strings plus 3000 random/structured paths; only al is meaningful (the original leaves garbage in the upper bits of eax, we return 0/1). Mutant (drop the "\." check): killed. Hooked.

name: IsCanonicalAbsolutePathString(const cRZString*)
notes: Same test (compared against the const char* form and against the original on cRZString arguments). Hooked.

name: CombinePath(dest, path, maxlen, base) (base + \ + path, collapsing . and .., trailing separator kept)
notes: Test IniFile_CombinePath: ~19k cases (fixed bases x paths, random and component-structured paths, lengths around 0x208/0x209, several maxlen values, caller buffer and malloc'ed result), whole 0x240-byte output buffer compared. Mutants (>= to >, ':' check, trailing slash rule, '.' rule needing '\\' only, drive-root separator, maxlen compare): killed; `count > 0x209` survives and is equivalent (the later length >= 0x209 check rejects the same inputs). Hooked.

name: MakeAbsolutePath(dest, path, maxlen) (drive, UNC, rooted and relative paths)
notes: Test IniFile_MakeAbsolutePath, with the working directory set to three real directories in turn. The original's static CRT is not initialised in the harness, so the test redirects the two call sites of _getdrive (0x1c16c8) and _getdcwd (0x1c16f2) inside the original to the host's CRT (library functions: not under test); `X:rel` for a drive other than the current one is left out because _getdcwd for another drive fast-fails in this process (host CRT too). Mutant (lowercase drive letter not uppercased): killed; the 'C' fallback when _getdrive returns 0 is unreachable in the test (survives). Hooked.

name: AbsolutePathString(cRZString* out, const cRZString* in)
notes: Test IniFile_PathStrings (success flag in al, out text and capacity, inputs untouched). Hooked.

name: ResolvePathString(out, in, base): canonical absolute stays, else combine with base or the current drive
notes: Test IniFile_PathStrings (19k cases over the three wrappers). Mutants (null-base shortcut, skipped copy of an absolute path): killed. Hooked.

name: ConcatMove(out, left, right): out = left + right, right moved from (emptied)
notes: Test IniFile_ConcatMove: size grid around the 15/16 SSO boundary, reserved and unreserved right operands, a string concatenated with itself; out, capacity and the emptied operand compared. Hooked.

name: cRZIniFile::cRZIniFile(const cIGZString& path)
notes: Test IniFile_IniFileRead: 1500 pairs (original vs ours, same ini text in separate sandbox files, filler bytes in the object), compared after construction: path string, flags, padding, table sizes and the created cRZFile (refs, buffers, path). The two tables are std::map<IniKey, uint32_t> (0x34-byte nodes: cRZString key, file offset) and std::map<IniKey, IniKey> (0x50-byte nodes); the key order is std::string operator<. Mutants (loaded=true, buffer 0x800): killed. Hooked.

name: cRZIniFile::~cRZIniFile (body)
notes: Same test: a second reference is held on each file to compare the refcount and open state after the destructor (closes an open file, releases the object's reference, frees the tables by erasing the nodes the original's loader inserted). Mutants (skipped Release, skipped Close): killed. Hooked.

name: cRZIniFile::vf0 (deleting destructor)
notes: Same test, flags 0 and 1: returns this and the 0x40-byte block is freed (HeapValidate right after the call) only for flags & 1. Mutants (flags & 2, always delete): killed. Hooked.

name: cRZIniFile::vf6 GetString(section, key, cRZString* out)
notes: Same test: up to 14 lookups per object on random ini text (comments, indented and padded lines, mixed case, tabs, '=' inside values, empty values, missing files, sections repeated under different case), enabled and disabled objects; return, out string (text, capacity), arguments, loaded flag, table sizes and file state compared. The load (slot 17), Clear (slot 5) and ReadLine (slot 18) stay the game's, called through the vtable. Mutants (header line not consumed, comment char, section end, trimming, case, position check, Clear when disabled): killed; two survivors are equivalent or unreachable (skipping `line.resize(0)` before the line is destroyed is unobservable; `position <= length` needs a recorded header offset equal to the file length, which loads never record). Hooked.

name: cRZString::TrimLeading (erase leading space/tab)
notes: Test IniFile_StringHelpers (6000 random blank-heavy strings incl. heap-sized). Mutant (space only): killed. Hooked.

name: cRZString::TrimTrailing (erase trailing space/tab)
notes: Test IniFile_StringHelpers. Mutant (off by one): killed. Hooked.

name: cRZString::SplitOff(out, delimiter)
notes: Test IniFile_StringHelpers over 8 delimiters incl. null, empty, multi-char and absent. Mutant (delimiter not erased): killed. Hooked.

name: cGZFileSystem::DataDirectory (slot 7)
notes: Test IniFile_DataDirectory: 700 runs on a fake face (slots 4 and 5 are logging fakes), a sandboxed <dir><name>.ini with random [Directories] Data= values (also missing file, missing key, padded lines), preset directory strings and the already-set flag; returned text, the whole object (strings with capacity, flags, other bytes) and the slot-call log compared. Mutants (flag not set, base dropped for the resolve): killed. In effect through callers (standalone shape, lane KU): a real class with its own vtables; the constructor hook cGZFileSystem_Construct (and cTSAppFW::AddApplicationServicesHere, which builds it with our constructor) keeps the game's vtables off every object, so the slot adapter is gone.

name: cGZFileSystem::PlugInDirectory (slot 8)
notes: Test IniFile_PlugInDirectory (same setup; the empty case appends the plug-in directory name and a backslash, with slot 4 called twice). Mutant (trailing '/'): killed; the key 'Plugin' mutant survives because the lookup lowercases (equivalent). In effect through callers (standalone shape, lane KU): a real class with its own vtables; the constructor hook cGZFileSystem_Construct (and cTSAppFW::AddApplicationServicesHere, which builds it with our constructor) keeps the game's vtables off every object, so the slot adapter is gone.
